reason: A durable browser-based task board for planning, executing, reviewing, and tracking agent-backed work through DeepSeek Harness Sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化任务看板，用于创建、规划、执行、审核和跟踪由智能体支持的任务。
summaries.en: A durable task board for DeepSeek Harness that lets users plan, execute, review, and track agent-backed work.

capabilities: Create and persist task cards with descriptions, acceptance criteria, workspaces, presets, and image attachments
Edit, reorder, reopen, delete, and review task cards
Start or stop task execution through DSH Sessions
Approve, reject with feedback, retry, and send follow-up work
Inspect task-round activity and session history
Refresh the browser projection from the authoritative host snapshot
